name: @dsh-external/dsh-upstream-fixes
description: Compatibility fixes for broken third-party dsh plugins: makes dsh-auto-approval's scoped package references resolve to the published bare-named packages, shims dsh-sidechain's deep client import onto the public runtime client entry, aliases the legacy httpServer service for dsh-vision-toolkit, and gives the plugin-console panel real update support (git pull / pnpm update --latest).
